result.quote: “You will see it with your own eyes,” replied Elisha, “but you will not eat any of it.”
result.reason: The key is supported: the unbelieving officer will not eat the promised flour or barley. However, the broad question also permits the distinct answer that he will see the event with his own eyes. In addition, the window calls him an “officer,” not a captain, so that designation should be revised.
